accuracyNotes: Temperature=0 is often greedy but not a universal determinism guarantee; provider behaviors vary.
Approximate token-to-word ratios are language- and tokenizer-dependent; do not present 0.75 as universal.
JSON Schema or structured-output support does not guarantee semantic factual correctness; still validate.
CoT/ToT lessons teach verifiable problem decomposition, not mandatory disclosure of private model reasoning.
Prompt injection cannot be solved by sanitization or wording alone; enforce tool permissions and trust boundaries.
Model provider model names, API features and availability are volatile; do not bake current model inventories into the curriculum.
